integrity: The precise assumptions, sharp coefficient, and uniform remainder are proved in RESULT.md; the numerical checker is corroborative.
scientific_limitations: The law applies only to invariantly selected affine-line chords of the specified Reuleaux triangle in the terminal regime. Historical priority remains provisional because an older general chord-distribution article was available only by abstract. Independent mathematical validation was not performed.
title: A logarithmic terminal chord law for the Reuleaux triangle
